concept.name: firefox_decodertraits_mp4_compat_tweak_20260629
concept.human_rationale: Restored missing generic MP4 container query support in DecoderTraits.cpp. This prevents JavaScript HTML5 players (like Video.js, Hls.js, Shaka Player) from assuming the browser has zero MP4 support when they perform generic canPlayType('video/mp4') queries.
